entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Applicant :- Gulshan Kumar Chauhan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. Deptt.
Of Home Lucknow

Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjeev Kumar Shukla,Harendra Singh,Satish Kumar Sharma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard Shri Harendra Singh learned for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. In terms of the F.I.R., it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 20 years was married to the applicant in a love marriage.
However, she was misbehaved by the entire matrimonial family and demand of dowry was also made.
Subsequently, on 26.9.2022, she committed suicide.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant argues that prior to the marriage, an F.I.R. was lodged under Section 376 I.P.C., however the wife of the applicant and the daughter of the informant turned hostile and subsequently, both of them got married.

He further argued that even as per the post Gulshan Kumar Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy. ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62676943/
1 mortem report, the cause of death is ante mortem hanging.

entities.text: Gulshan Kumar Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Its Prin. Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He argued that apart from ligature mark, there is lacerated wound which has not been referred to as the cause of death.
He argued that out of the twelve witnesses, only one witness has been examined so far and thus, there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in the near future.
The other two co accused have already been enlarged on bail although the applicant does not claim parity.

The applicant is in jail since 28.9.2022 and the applicant has no criminal history, hence the applicant may be released on bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the fact that the marriage between the applicant and the deceased was a love marriage and there is no document to demonstrate that soon before the death, the deceased was subjected to any physical or mental harassment in relation to the demand of dowry particularly the fact that the applicant is in custody since 28.9.2022 and has no criminal history and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Gulshan Kumar Chauhan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.327 of 2022, under Sections 498-A, 304-B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kursi, District Barabanki on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024 Shukla  Gulshan Kumar Chauhan vs State Of U.P. Thru.
